senses.sense_definition: Providing necessary support to the primary activities or operation of an organization, system, or main task.

examples.text: The hospital hired additional <w>ancillary</w> staff to support the doctors during the peak season.text
She plays an <w>ancillary</w> role in the project, helping with organization rather than main development.text

senses.sense_definition: A person, device, or component that provides supplementary support to a primary system, machine, or organization.

examples.text: The cost of the main machinery includes all necessary <w>ancillaries</w> for operation.text
This piece of equipment functions as an <w>ancillary</w> to speed up the main production process.text
